tools.name: list_policies
tools.description: Read-only home, car and business insurance administration: list existing policies and renewal dates. No health-related policies, documents, uploads, claims, coverage advice or healthcare services. Returns policy reference, type, insurer and dates only.

tools.name: get_renewals
tools.description: List renewal dates for existing home, car and business policies within 1–365 days (default 90). Health-related policies and documents are excluded.
